correctness.rationale: The frame space of four independent central hyperplanes has dimension 12. Evenness reduces the 16 cone volumes to 7 independent defects and each of four 8-piece central sections to 3 defects, for 19 total. Even interior bump pairs can span the 7 cone defects while avoiding all four hyperplanes; for each section, four bump pairs supported on that hyperplane away from the other three span its 3-dimensional sum-zero section-defect space. The h-derivative is therefore block-triangular and onto. Parametric transversality then makes the partial 12-dimensional frame map transverse to 0 for a comeager set of small even C^2 perturbations, which is impossible at a zero because 12<19. Small perturbations preserve smooth strict convexity.
